sloka: यथा तातं दशरथं यथा ऽजं च पितामहम् ।तथा भवन्तमासाद्य हृदयं मे प्रसीदति ।। ६.५०.४३ ।।।।
transliteration: yathā tātaṁ daśarathaṁ yathā 'jaṁ ca pitāmaham ।tathā bhavantamāsādya hṛdayaṁ me prasīdati ।। 6.50.43 ।।।।

translations.english: "For me to meet you is like meeting my father Dasaratha and grandfather, Aja. My heart rejoices."
